customManagers.description: The image pins in scripts/images.ts, and the quoted build args of the ci:local runner in .github/compose.ci.yaml. The same depName in compose files, ci.yml and the Dockerfiles lands in the same PR, so the copies stay equal (`pnpm ci:workflows` checks).
The Node version pnpm downloads (package.json devEngines.runtime).

packageRules.description: Docker Hub and GHCR do not always report a release time; without this, image updates would wait forever.
effect and @effect/vitest are released together and move in one PR.
The stable 0.99.0 crashes on TypeScript 7 (ADR 0002); stay on the next snapshots.
The node image and devEngines move together.
The Playwright image ships the browsers of one library version.
@types/node follows the Node major in devEngines.
